whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr Monika Multispeciality Dental Clinic,

I noticed your dental clinic is well-located in Mithapur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new patient inquiries.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, treatments menu, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/drmonika

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dr Monika / Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic (Dr Monika Multispeciality Dental Clinic) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp appointment booking, and a clean showcase of your dental treatments in Mithapur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
